name: Sun Ke-fang
bio: Sun Ke-Fang is a Taiwanese actress born on November 2, 1987. She is known for her work in television series and films such her performances as Hsieh Tzu-ya in"On Marriage" (2022), Clara Wang in "Accidental Influencer" (2024), Chen "Jia-jia" Wan-jia in "Little Big Women"(2020) and Dragon Girl in "Brave Animated Series" (2021).
